expectations.text: Defines it: Art. 28(3) register of all contractual arrangements on ICT third-party services, at entity/sub-consolidated/consolidated level, in the ESA-prescribed template
expectations.evidence: 'Article 28(3)' register of 'all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers', 'standardized templates published via the RTS/ITS', 'maintained at both entity and, where applicable, consolidated/group level'.

expectations.text: States the cycle: annual regulator collection — the 2026 round used reference date December 31, 2025 with NCA submission windows in Q1 2026 (most deadlines around March 31, the NCA-to-ESA backstop)
expectations.evidence: Hedges the 2026 cycle: 'reflecting a 2025 year-end or similarly defined reference date, depending on your national competent authority's exact calendar'; no 31 Dec 2025 reference date, no Q1 2026/31 March window.

expectations.text: Notes its function: feeds CTPP criticality designation and oversight
expectations.evidence: 'it feeds the European Supervisory Authorities' process for identifying Critical ICT Third-Party Providers (CTPPs)... which is how CTPP designations get made'.

expectations.text: Advises continuous maintenance (updates on new/changed/terminated arrangements) rather than year-end scrambles
expectations.evidence: 'maintain the register on an ongoing/live basis internally - not just as an annual compliance exercise'; 'Treat the RoI as a living document'.

expectations.text: Connects to related duties: pre-contract due diligence, Art. 30 contract provisions, and exit strategies for critical/important functions
expectations.evidence: Mentions exit-strategy planning, but no pre-contract due diligence and no Art. 30 contract-provision linkage.
